column1: # Corpus gates (review R4, 2026-08-27) — the bars and sets a round must hold; `recompile::gates` reads this
# file (war2_survey post-emit, recompile_check post-verdict, examples/corpus_gates.rs). One row per bar or TU:
#   gate: string_ops_bar | chain | switch_labels | guard_frame | guard_volatile
#   rule: `>=` the count is a FLOOR; `==` the count is exact; `no-switch` the TU prints no `switch (`;
#   set_at: the round (and commit) the row was set at — a landing that legitimately moves a row re-stamps it here.
# string_ops_bar counts `memcpy(` / `memset(` / `memcmp(` / `strlen(` over the TUs in scope (the survey's scope
# = manifest kind=user). Set at w6a under kind=user (2,803 TUs); the same tree under the VA cut < 0x5191e
